verdicts.reason: Both have the same failure. The green forest background covers only a narrow centre strip and the rest of the canvas is white, so the white headline ('Special Event Devoted to International Day of Forests') and subhead ('Joint celebration & Forest cleanup') disappear outside the strip and read only as fragments. The pale yellow 'March 21' and the divider rules float on white with almost no contrast, and the quote and URL body copy are missing. B frames the date between two rules and A leaves one rule stranded on the right, but neither is usable.
